cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a craftsman's workshop of her world — adjusts a small mechanism on the work surface with a small screwdriver; a Korean jjimjilbang hall with heated floors and sleeping mats — dries her hair with a towel; the open deck of a wooden sightseeing boat on the Yangtze — standing; the back seat of a taxi at night — touches one ear cup of a pair of over-ear headphones hung around her neck; a club powder room with a lit mirror and neon on the tiles — touches one ear cup of a pair of over-ear headphones hung around her neck; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — standing; a forest path in her world — standing; a candlelit gala dinner hall — holds a cup in both hands; a stairwell landing with a tall window — carries a small storage box against her waist; a walled garden with a lotus pond — lifts a small hand lantern to chest height; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — standing; the stone stairway up to an old city gate tower — sweeps the floor beside her with a small hand brush; a roller rink under coloured lights — holds a water bottle at chest height
